label: SAP MDG
role: The point of control for customer creation and governance: every commercial customer is created here. It runs duplicate checks on identifiers, validates addresses, applies authorization groups by line of business and generates the canonical SAP customer number. It is the system of record for the customer and holds the tax ID and bank data.

label: SAP S/4HANA
role: The financial system of record. It receives the business partner from SAP MDG, with company codes, sales areas and partner roles, adds credit and collection data, and takes transaction postings and invoices from the execution systems.

label: Salesforce
role: Where a prospect is first captured and a new customer setup and credit check start, on two tracks: Trade (the commodity trading desk) and CRM/Basic (goods and products). It triggers creation in SAP MDG, receives the SAP customer number back, and serves the customer portal.

label: RightAngle
role: The commercial and logistics system for trading, deals, scheduling and financial exposure. It takes basic customer data from SAP MDG, creates the business associate and its locations, sends the business associate ID and locale back to SAP MDG, and shares data with Kittyhawk and the trading desks.

label: Polaris
role: The pipeline operations and invoicing system. It takes the SAP customer number and basic attributes from SAP MDG, adds operational data, records pipeline movements and revenue, and sends the transport invoices it generates to SAP S/4HANA.

label: Dealer Master
role: The system of record for the branded dealer network: brand customers and their stations and ship-tos. It is built on Salesforce and aggregates station point-of-sale transactions executed in other systems. Jobbers start here and go to SAP MDG; direct dealers start in SAP MDG and come here. It sends bank and payment details to SAP S/4HANA.

label: MAGIC
alt_labels: Marketing Applications Graphical Interface for Clients
role: The new customer account integration: it assigns the SAP MDG customer number and the Kittyhawk territory manager to Salesforce, converts the prospect into a customer account, and syncs the customer number, name, address, FEIN, status, credit monitor and territory manager every day.

label: KittyHawk
role: Records physical product movements. It receives customers from RightAngle, holds the territory manager, and feeds Gravitate and MAGIC.

label: Quorum
role: Records gathering and processing movements and settlements; it receives customers from SAP MDG and enriches them through the contract or relationship.

label: Profisee
role: Customer data storage and mastering used by IDP, for customer ID mapping, customer roll-ups and cross-references.

label: Bridger Insight
role: The compliance check of a customer against government watchlists.

label: Gravitate
role: The gathering and processing customer portal.

label: Star
role: Records crude movement tickets.

label: Terminal download
role: Sends customer data to terminals so the customer can load there.

label: Tax Image Silo
role: Holds the customer's state sales tax exemption certificates.

label: Allocation Manager
role: Derives operational decisions for a customer, such as locks and limits.

label: Sirion
role: Enriches the customer before the customer is assigned to a contract.

label: TFR
role: Calculates and processes freight.

label: TMIS
role: The master data repository of carrier contracts and rates.

label: OneSource
role: Calculates tax and supports tax compliance and reporting, for RightAngle and SAP S/4HANA invoices.

label: RCMS
role: The renewable compliance system: a reference ID tied to a fuel movement or a RIN trade.

label: Data Products IDP
role: Data products on the customer master, sales, credit exposure and delinquency.

label: FuelFacs
role: Terminal data on suppliers, products and carriers; it receives customer data from Terminal download.

label: TASDM
role: Creates the customers and destinations of MPLX's third-party suppliers in the terminal automation system.

label: Terminal Upload
role: Enriches the customer through cross-reference customer ID mapping.

label: XREF
role: The cross-reference on the Salesforce to RightAngle interface that excludes specific customers.

label: Information Steward
role: Monitors customer data quality.

label: TMT
role: A system downstream of MAGIC that sends customer data to Profisee.

label: Federal Health
role: A system downstream of MAGIC that sends customer data to Profisee.

label: Gas Buddy
role: A system downstream of MAGIC that sends customer data to Profisee.

label: Drop Tank
role: A system downstream of MAGIC that sends customer data to Profisee.

label: EMK3
role: A system downstream of MAGIC that sends customer data to Profisee.

label: Customer Portal
role: The customer portal; it sends customer data to Profisee.

label: DTN File Server
role: A file server downstream of MAGIC that sends customer data to Profisee.

label: Terminal Audit System
role: A source of terminal customers.

label: FlowCal
role: A source of pipeline customers for midstream supply.

label: EIS
role: A source of forecast-driven customers.

label: Asphalt Marketing System
role: A source of asphalt and bitumen customers.

label: Brand Credit Card System
role: A source of dealers.

label: Terminal Margin Ranking System
role: A source of brand and wholesale customers.

label: Corp_Vetting
role: A source of partner roles: vendor, surety and customer.

label: Lenel Onguard
role: A source of employee parties.
